show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/tsy2Cb
show.description: Ghayal Mukkabaz is a gritty boxing drama about Veer, a wounded former boxer hiding his lethal punches behind a cleaner’s mop, who must step back into the ring to protect a threatened academy, confront a ruthless boxing mafia, and unleash the fighter he has kept buried.
